description:
The Chinook music store database is currently open. You need to perform a cleanup operation:

1. Delete the invoice with InvoiceId 412 (and its associated invoice lines).
2. Reset the auto-increment sequence for the Invoice table so the next record starts at ID 1000. Use the 'Tools > SQL' window to execute the necessary HSQLDB command (`ALTER TABLE "Invoice" ALTER COLUMN "InvoiceId" RESTART WITH 1000`).
3. Save the database file to persist these changes.
